diagnosis: CustomerInvoiceDetailView inherits from APIView and queries Invoice.objects.get(id=invoice_id) directly. Unlike GenericAPIView's get_object(), APIView does not automatically invoke has_object_permission() on its permission_classes unless self.check_object_permissions(request, invoice) is explicitly called. Consequently, IsInvoiceOwner is bypassed entirely.
